title: CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 02-25, 2025 Federal Poverty Level Changes (FPL) Income Changes

sections.title: CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 02-25, 2025 FEDERAL POVERTY LEVEL CHANGES (FPL) INCOME CHANGES
sections.content_text:
DATE: JANAURY 29, 2025
Manual:
Aged, Blind, and Disabled Medicaid
Change No:
02-25
To:
County Directors of Social Services

sections.title: I. BACKGROUND AND CONTENT OF CHANGE
sections.content_text: Federal law requires poverty levels to be adjusted annually on the basis of the Consumer Price Index (CPI). This letter issues the 2025 Federal Poverty Level (FPL) income limit effective April 1, 2025.

sections.title: II. POLICY UPDATE
sections.content_text: MA-2252, Non-MAGI Medicaid Income/Reserve Limits, has been updated with 2025 amounts.
